scientific_integrity: An exact identity and a complete 46-shape finite enumeration are provided with standalone exact-arithmetic checker. Same-model review is not independent replication or publication certification.
scientific_limitations: Unit positive edges, unlabeled rooted nonplane full-binary shapes, homogeneous independent leaf survival and complete probability-response curves only. No claim for heterogeneity, finite-noisy observations, named-taxon reconstruction, or nonbinary trees. Historical priority requires external assessment, particularly the uninspected full preprint of Faller–Pardi–Steel.
title: First mean-phylogenetic-diversity ambiguity at nine taxa, resolved by variance
